author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert didn’t start strong, but has since turned its mechanics around in a way that would make the Greymanes proud. But how has it managed that? Well, the simple answer would be that the developer just paid attention to all of the Greymanes among us. 

But it goes deeper than that. It could have been easy for the the developer to just throw a few patches our way and call it a day. However, what we’ve got is turning out to be a masterclass in damage control and goodwill farming, and the latest developer update from the game is evidence of that.

Join us as we dive into why that’s the case, and why we think visiting Pywel is going to be even better as the new changes rollout over the next couple of months.

Note: These updates will release from April to June.
title: Crimson Desert's Biggest Upcoming Changes Are Exactly What Fans Wanted

author: GamingBolt
description:
SAMSON hasn’t had the perfect start Liquid Swords might have hoped for, and there are credible reasons behind that disappointing launch response. But does that mean a title holding so much potential is done? 

We don’t think so, given the developers' continued faith in it and our own positive impressions of its strengths. But why do we remain optimistic about its chances? Join us as we take a deeper look at what went wrong with SAMSON and how it could still become a compelling addition to the crime action genre thanks to its innovative ideas and a gritty world serving a solid premise.
title: What The Hell Happened To Samson?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Despite the current generation of games being as awesome as it is, it's always good to go back to an era of gaming where our games were more trusting of our ability to figure them out. 

Playing Skyrim on the PS3 for the first time was sure to have been a chaotic romp through the world, your ignorance of the game’s mechanics and systems leading you down paths you couldn’t have imagined for your characters. 

And of course, learning more about what went wrong from your fellow players in online communities was always part of the fun. Well, that’s just another great aspect of gaming that Crimson Desert has managed to pack into Pywel, and it's one that has us over the moon everytime we watch Kliff walk through that portal when we boot up our save.

title: Crimson Desert Made Me Feel Like A Gamer All Over Again
